context:
Goal: q_max's CI-speed lanes merge tonight, one lane per merge, as you picked on item 820.
Problem (rule): q_max's decision only-a-batch-runs-ci runs CI only on a PR whose head branch starts with batch-. A ready lane PR from any other branch never goes green: q_max PR #1171, run 43566092927 is red, all-jobs-passed fails with every other job skipped. So item 820 c's act (merge a lane's own PR on its own green run) cannot happen in q_max. The coordinator picked a way round it, undoable and not yours: runner 12 opens a batch-<slug> branch on each lane head and merges that on its green run, a batch of one.
Based on (record): the coordinator's 00:32 CST message, relayed; q_max's decision only-a-batch-runs-ci (quoted by the coordinator, not read by triage); your ruling own-820-c-five-repos (read by triage). Unchecked: PR #1171's run.
Departs from: main — your grant (item 820 c) names a lane's own PR; a lets runner 12 merge a second PR per lane (the batch-<slug> branch) in q_max; b changes q_max's own rule so CI runs on any ready PR; c leaves q_max waiting.
Meanwhile: the lanes in q_max keep working; the coordinator's pick stands as its own undoable pick, and runner 12 opens the batch branches. Triage recommends runner 12 does not merge in q_max until you answer; the coordinator decides that.

short: q_max: merge a batch-of-one branch, change q_max's CI rule, or wait?
title: q_max's CI only runs on a PR whose branch starts with batch-, so a lane's own PR can never go green there. May runner 12 merge a one-lane batch-<slug> branch instead (a), will you change q_max's rule so CI runs on any ready PR (b), or wait (c)?
why: Your 00:19 CST pick (item 820 c) lets runner 12 merge a lane's own PR on its own green run. In q_max that PR can never go green, so the grant cannot be used as written. A batch-of-one is a second PR per lane, which is a variant of what you named, and only you widen a grant.
